outcome.technical: Release guard: main() runs the decision inside try/except BaseException (KeyboardInterrupt kept, said in the comment); any error is a deny 'Release decision UNKNOWN: this guard could not finish deciding (<Type>: <text, cut at 400>), so the command is refused rather than let through on a question nobody answered - repair what it names and retry.'; a payload that does not parse or is not an object stays fail-open (ug8); a closed stdout gives exit 2 with the reason on stderr (ug9); approved second hunk refuses on unreadablePlanFiles through plan_read_sentence; docstring sentence reworded off 'from the ledger alone'. arm-release-bypass says a raising guard reading as unreadable (rb20). _evidence_io: record_problem checks a record (and its repeatedRun and baseRed.baseRuns) against the published lastRun through _json_schema; read_rows adds unreadableRecords and labels them in unreadablePlanFiles; one sentence unreadable_records_sentence/plan_read_sentence used by status (header line + --json unreadableRecords [{file,scope,subject,key,field,why}], present only when non-empty), render-report (stderr WARNING) and _evidence_view (planReadError), the panel state payload (unreadableRecords, unreadablePlanSaid), the doctor ('run records' row), the binding and close-phase (refused, way on: re-recording replaces the record, mr2). Neither the report page nor the panel UI displays the sentence: the report says it on stderr and in the evidence view's data, the panel carries it in the state payload. record_row's identity comes from placement; RECORD_ONLY_KEYS is one table read in both directions (record_row drops, _record_of excludes; RECORD_ONLY_READ re-admitted). Drive 2c: replaced launches counted (replacedBefore), cancelled count carried, asked at CANCELLED_BOUND, a cut launch said as cut; base wait untouched. Binding refuses naming sharedUnresolved paths; gate_banners says a cut tree-changed list as cut. R56 oneOf + share arm requires repeatedRun and type array; R57 rk walks per-table conjuncts, one composed record per status, group copy composed (rk1/rk2/rk7/rk8); R58 the clause the finding names removed. Out-of-scope suites brought into the files by the coordinator: test__manifest_vocab names _evidence_io as a $defs reader (mv36); ve2 and ctw64 fixtures now leave the writer's no-run shape, and twins ve2h (audit-task signoff) and ctw64h (commit-task-work) keep the hand-edited fixture and assert the unreadable arm naming file, subject and field. Brief gate exit 0: 5/5 files ok, 1927 cases (bq4 green this run). Three suites + dependants exit 0: 14/14 files ok, 3692 cases. Full sweep exit 0: 198/198 files ok, 19614 cases. ruff, vermin, gate-parity, check-rendered-artifacts --before-commit, check-example-ledgers, measure-context --gate, check-git-pipeline, bench-hooks --gate (3.14.7 only) all exit 0; count-ui-pins --json identical before/after (cmp 0).
outcome.descriptive: A malformed or hand-edited run record no longer crashes a reader or passes a release: the guard refuses on what it cannot read, every reader names the file, subject and field, and a record's identity is where it sits.
